capabilities: Trigger autocomplete manually with a command or hotkey, or automatically while typing after a configurable number of characters
Suggest completions from words already written in the current session
Complete LaTeX functions and place the cursor at a function parameter
Tokenize words for multiple languages (Arabic, Japanese, default) with per-language word separators
Navigate suggestions with arrow keys or Ctrl-n/p and accept with enter or tab
extras: Author states the plugin is no longer maintained because they stopped using Obsidian, and that it is still WIP; bug reports go through GitHub issues. Feature list mixes shipped and planned items (unchecked boxes for snippets, custom-file provider, context-aware LaTeX triggers).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in autocomplete to speed up typing or complete words and LaTeX functions.

relations.evidence: please use other plugins like Obsidian completr

summary: Typing autocomplete popup that suggests words from the current file session and LaTeX completions, triggered manually or automatically while writing.
